title: Bret Hart vs. Steve Austin: the double turn
summary: Austin’s challenge draws Bret back into a bitter rivalry. Their WrestleMania submission match changes how the audience sees both men.

chapters.title: Bret defeats Austin on his return
chapters.context: Hart returns to a major singles match against the increasingly confrontational Austin.

chapters.title: Austin refuses to submit
chapters.result: Hart wins when Austin passes out in the Sharpshooter.
chapters.context: Austin’s refusal to quit helps recast him as the fan favorite while Hart becomes the antagonist.
